v4.6.87 — Day bot enforces stops at the open + never carries overnight

🐛 FIXED
• The day bot only managed positions inside its trading routine, which it SKIPS during the first/last 15 minutes (the 'too early / too close' window). So a holding that gapped past its stop at the open just sat there until the window passed. It now enforces stop-loss / take-profit on open positions EVERY cycle the market is open — it only withholds NEW entries during those windows.
• The end-of-day flatten could be skipped: the ~30-minute cycle could jump clean over the 15-minute closing window, leaving a position overnight. The bot now always wakes for the closing window (and polls each minute inside it), so it reliably flattens before the bell — no overnight carry.

Applies to Alpaca and IBKR day bots (server-side too).

Update via the in-app banner.
